outcome_detail: $425,000 settlement placed before the Phoenix City Council for approval on November 17, 2021; reporting describes both Pena accusers as having been paid $425,000 each by the city in 2021.
criminal_detail: Pena was indicted in August 2020 on seven felony counts involving three women, including the plaintiff in this suit. A jury acquitted him on two counts and deadlocked on five in May 2022; a retrial jury acquitted him on all remaining counts in August 2022.
description: A second woman sued former Phoenix police officer Sean Pena and the City of Phoenix on June 18, 2021, in Maricopa County Superior Court; the case was later moved to the U.S. District Court for the District of Arizona. The complaint alleges that on August 5, 2019, after responding to her call for service, Pena sexually assaulted her in two encounters that evening, including forced sexual contact inside his patrol vehicle. The suit also alleges the department failed to properly investigate a 2018 sexual assault report against Pena or increase his supervision. The city settled the claim for $425,000, with the settlement before the City Council in November 2021. Pena was acquitted of all criminal charges across two trials in 2022.
notes: Companion record to rec-21 (first accuser's suit, settled June 2021); both arise from the same scandal involving ex-officer Sean Pena.
